title: MQTT Client Publish
text: Publish messages to MQTT Topics, 1 input; {Client} selects MQTT client, {Topics to publish} sets the list of MQTT, {Publish only on input data change} Determines when to publish messages and {Block sample time} sets the sample time for read operation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Topic_ x
ports.summary: Messages to publish to MQTT topics double

params.name: Publish only on input data change
params.values: Determines when to publish messages on (default) | off

params.name: Block sample time
params.values: Sample time for read operation -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar
